cancel_in_progress_false_allowlist.collate-changes.yml: Batch collation updates one rolling bot PR; cancel mid-run leaves bot/collate-changes inconsistent and recreates cancelled main runs from overlap.
cancel_in_progress_false_allowlist.conflict-disarm.yml: Conflict disarm must finish PR label and queue mutations; cancel mid-run risks half-applied disarm state.
cancel_in_progress_false_allowlist.arm-cap-reconcile.yml: Armed-PR inventory reconcile must finish SQLite inventory sync before optional disarm dispatch; cancel mid-run risks cap drift.
cancel_in_progress_false_allowlist.deploy-qualified-release.yml: A root deployment transaction must reach commit or rollback and cannot be interrupted safely.
cancel_in_progress_false_allowlist.release.yml: Release publishing must not be interrupted after versioning and tag orchestration begin.
cancel_in_progress_false_allowlist.main-ci-auto-release.yml: Per-SHA release packaging runs npm ci, wheelhouse build, and gh release create; workflow_run overlap must not cancel an in-flight publish for the same commit.

pr_concurrency_singleton_allowlist.Agent-Redundant-PR-Closer.yml: Duplicate PR arbitration intentionally runs as one repo-wide singleton to compare all open PRs.
